q1_issues.issue: "locked into annual breeding cycles" takes Goal although nothing moves and no path is described; the surface-preposition oblique (Into …) is the faithful record, Goal being the motion-result head (the become/turn-into rule expressly bars a spatial Goal for a non-motion "into").
The parenthetical "like wolves" is attached to the locking event as (Like <event> wolf), which says the locking resembles a wolf rather than that the same predication holds of wolves too.

q2_gaps: comparative parenthetical "X, like Y, VP" — asserting that the predication also holds of Y has no licensed encoding; the (Like …) oblique records only a resemblance and forces an arbitrary choice between the event and the subject as its first argument
notes: Both compounds decompose correctly — adjectival modifiers pure/annual exposed, the noun modifier "breeding" left inside the symbol — and the bare-plural generic takes the distributing rule at 0.9/0.9 with Still as an opaque tag and Manner keeping the -ly surface form "genetically".
